compiled_state.title: [reconciler]: T3 inbound label add still fails AND ghost 'dso-id:jira-dig-*' label appears on Jira for bound tickets
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
On verify/all-3-pending-fixes (main + #458 + #459 + #460), labels probe results:
- T1 OB-ADD: PASS
- T2 OB-REMOVE: PASS (bc8f wipe FIXED)
- **T3 IB-ADD: FAIL** — Jira side adds 'ib-added-...', local stays at ['labelprobe-...']
- T4 IB-REMOVE: vacuous PASS

Also observed: Jira ends up with extra **'dso-id:jira-dig-5026'** label after T1 outbound — this is 1bb2-pattern leakage. The 1bb2 fix addressed inbound_update writing to wrong dir, but ANOTHER code path is treating the bound jira_key as a separate local entity and writing a dso-id label naming it.

## Reproduction
verify/all-3-pending-fixes branch (fdda310bca) + DSO_RECONCILER_LOCK_RETRY_BUDGET=20 bash /tmp/labels-probe.sh
- e486-70b3-c960-4f2d ↔ DIG-5026
- After T1 outbound: Jira labels include 'dso-id:e486-...' (correct) AND 'dso-id:jira-dig-5026' (ghost — wrong)
- T3 inbound: local doesn't pick up 'ib-added-...'

## Hypotheses
1. 'dso-id:jira-dig-5026' ghost = inbound_create being called for the just-bound DIG-5026 (creating jira-dig-5026 as a separate local entity with its own dso-id) — same root pattern as 1bb2 but in a different call site.
2. T3 IB-ADD failure may be downstream of the ghost — the inbound differ may be acting on jira-dig-5026 instead of e486-...

## Affected Files
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py — search for sites that write 'dso-id:' labels via add_label (around _apply_inbound_create / _apply_outbound_create); these should NOT fire for already-bound tickets

**code_version**: fdda310bcab4c05a0aa0e80a6cc623e9b20dd2d7
